about: Image and media registry for the My Dealer redesign (IMAGERY lane). photos: the client's own photos and film stills (alts reuse the captured alts where they exist). generated: AI-generated illustrative stills in assets/generated (the build makes WebP variants; use gimg(id)). media: the AI smoke loop and the client's brand film.

loop-smoke.use: seamless loop (forward then reverse): muted, loop, playsinline, decorative (aria-hidden); show the poster and do not autoplay under prefers-reduced-motion
loop-smoke.note: AI-generated illustrative motion (Higgsfield kling-video/v3.0-turbo/image-to-video, animated from the AI-generated still g-smoke; forward-then-reverse loop). IPTC digital source type: http://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/digitalsourcetype/trainedAlgorithmicMedia. Not footage of My Dealer (mydealermn.com), its store, staff, customers, products or brands.

brand-film.note: The client's own brand film (the dealer character comes to life): the home hero film, as on the live site. Not made by this redesign and not AI-generated by it.
